name: AML FLT3-ITD Patient-Specific Drug Resistance Network
citation: Palma et al. (2021) J. Pers. Med. 11(2):117

rules.BCL2: (STAT5  or  PI3K_AKT  or  NPM1_mut)  and   not P53
rules.MCL1: (PI3K_AKT  or  PIM  or  STAT5)  and   not BAX_BAK
rules.P53: not DNMT3A_mut  and   not MDM2  and   not BCL2
rules.BAX_BAK: (P53  or   not BCL2)  and   not MCL1
rules.Proliferation: (MYC  or  STAT5  or  PI3K_AKT)  and   not Apoptosis
rules.Apoptosis: BAX_BAK  and   not BCL2  and   not MCL1
